entries.title: Detention

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for capture.

primary.why: The Windows PC Steam release is the best fidelity/capture route for Detention, while macOS/Linux, PS4, Switch, iOS, and Android have no sourced exclusive content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Detention on Steam or Red Candle's official store and play the Windows PC build. Use PS4, Switch, or mobile only for platform preference.
